answer: Because the glacier hash is checked against the terrace checkpoint at intake, the vine audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs hence has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Each duplicate costs another 68 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
